core_obligations: H3: Complete Crump-Young hybrid chemostat QSD, weighted exponential convergence and pointwise Yaglom theorem. Given the cited abstract QSD/semigroup criteria and ordinary drift/Markov/flow facts, the degenerate continuous component retains a Dirac part, so ordinary uniform density arguments do not give the hypotheses. The author constructs arbitrary-time compact-set accessibility by controlled jump/flow paths; a final2-to1 washout with random jump time produces a common absolutely continuous lower bound through a monotone flow composition/change of variables. Hitting-time estimates give the mass ratio away from deterministic equilibria, and a first-jump/Duhamel decomposition handles equilibrium neighborhoods. Together with singular boundary/exponential-population Lyapunov bounds these establish the actual model-specific criteria; a separate extension handles each initial point outside the invariant strip, including zero substrate. Count the complete QSD/convergence/Yaglom framework once, not twelve flow/hitting-time helper records. QSD uniqueness and uniform exponential estimates retain the original W-moment class, not all heavy-tailed distributions.
proof_roadmap: Model-specific arbitrary-time accessibility; last-washout common density; mass-ratio outside/near equilibria; singular Lyapunov estimates; abstract criterion and all-point initial-state extension.
